content:
T-022 (optional) policy decision: the template does NOT commit openapi.json and does NOT add a `git diff --exit-code` drift check. It keeps the aviary-aligned policy already in place — openapi.json is gitignored (.gitignore:31) and CI validates only that the spec generates and that the client builds from it (on-push.yml generate-openapi job).

Rationale:
1. Optional ticket; the fleet is split (aviary gitignores; keystore/metricstore commit). The richest reference (aviary) and the template's current state gitignore it.
2. A committed snapshot is wrong for a TEMPLATE: the un-instantiated template cannot generate openapi.json because `cargo make generate-openapi` runs `cargo build -p __SERVICE_NAME__` while the package is `__service_name__` (ISS-001). Any committed snapshot would be a placeholder or name-substituted artifact, and a drift check would fail on the first post-init build when the real service regenerates the spec with its own name/title.
3. Generation + client-consistency are already CI-enforced; only a committed-snapshot drift is unchecked, and that snapshot is the problematic part for a template.

To adopt the drift check in a DOWNSTREAM service (after init): commit openapi.json and add `git diff --exit-code openapi.json || (echo 'openapi.json is stale; run: cargo make generate-openapi' && exit 1)` to the generate-openapi task / job (keystore form). Revisit if/when ISS-001 is resolved.
title: Policy: openapi.json is gitignored, not committed (T-022 decision)
